emails.subject_summary: Request for official confirmation to reassure venue; reputational harm concerns
emails.body:
Hey PC Dixon
I need a way to demonstrate to one of my venues that I have police support and that I am the victim in this situation. I understand you cannot disclose much due to the ongoing investigation, and it’s best I don’t provide extensive evidence at this stage.

Given that Alanna is on bail and her statement was not followed up, I’m struggling with the perception of 'no smoke without fire'. I would appreciate any form of official confirmation that acknowledges:
• She is on bail.
• I am recognised as the victim.
• The police are supporting and protecting me.

The venue is PUCK (a coffee shop on her road). I need to reassure them of my position to protect my reputation and livelihood. If there is anything you can provide—within legal/procedural limits—that could help clarify the situation (without me having to provide my own evidence), I’d be grateful.

This is the worst bit — fear of not being believed. Tethis has said that if needed she would comply with anything to help proceedings. My ex-partners would also act as character witnesses. I’m slowly piecing my life back together, but the chaos and lies have been terrifying. If there’s anything you can legally provide I can use, my business solely relies on my reputation.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

emails.subject_summary: Bail confirmation and forwarded Paul Double case email
emails.body:
Hi Ben

It’s understandable to have concerns and worries, if you need additional support let me know and I can make referrals.

As per our conversation yesterday I can confirm that Alanna is still on bail. This was what is called Initial Bail to start with but as of 2nd February 2025 this bail period has been extended till 4th May 2025. The conditions to not contact you or attend your address remain the same, if she sees you in the street or at a venue for example she must make all reasonable effort to leave as soon as she becomes aware. The bail conditions apply to you as you are the victim and will remain as such while the investigation is ongoing.

I hope that this answers your query.

--- Forwarded message from Arran Shave, Norfolk Constabulary re: Paul DOUBLE breaches attached ---

The bail conditions apply to you as you are the victim and will remain as such while the investigation is ongoing.

emails.subject_summary: Chasing NICE links and statement; seeking medical support clarification
emails.body:
Hello mate I haven't heard back re NICE links or for the statement, I also really need to speak to the doctor, I'm finding it hard to get on with day to day tasks. I am happy to pay the doctor for a letter, as I am paying I expect I will be able to have a longer talk about my current situation and how I'm coping, which I'm not really.

My family has me under private health care, I called them in October as I was at my worst and had to go to my parents for 2 months, basically to stay alive. Would it be better just to arrange an appointment with them, would they be able to see my records and write me something up, or is it better to go through the NHS?

I want to co-operate, and at the moment my timeline has to be very structured as I have a lot of pressure to make out I'm ok, and fake confidence as I have 120 acts booked across 6 venues for May 2nd until June 1st for the Brighton Fringe, that's 50 shows I am promoting. It's the run up now so if you could please give me dates of when the statement will be taken, the NICE links. Also please tell me what it is exactly I am asking for from the doctor as my doctor is rubbish, I'd prefer to go private but I find just getting an appointment impossible even when I was able to live, without someone doing everything they can to make sure I don't.
